title: Add Travel Request API lifecycle to Expense Agent
summary: Travel Request API lifecycle management is integrated into the Expense Agent, enabling creation, approval, and rejection of travel requests through scoped OData endpoints with proper authorization and linked expense report generation.
key_points: Advertises the travelRequest capability and adds owner-scoped and approver-scoped travel request navigation in the API
Adds bound submit, approve and reject actions with authorization checks, status guards and audit fields
Approval creates one linked expense report; deleting a travel request is blocked while expense reports reference it
Normalizes local currency on API reads and writes and prevents PATCH from changing status or ownership
Emits submit, approve, auto-approve and reject usage events without identifiers; HTTP integration tests are disabled in CI
quote: Extends the Expense Agent beta API so travel requests can be managed through the same scoped OData model as expenses and expense reports.
